meta.objective: Execute the first live V4 launch loop: apply Gilardi and Zheng bundles into Convex, register paper-audit packages, create and launch baseline canary experiments, monitor their behavior, and write explicit promotion gates for moving from canaries to full headline matrix instantiation.

decisions.statement: Keep the experiment validator strict and fix the live bundle-apply surface instead of widening the schema for launch-only metadata.
Promote from baseline canary proving to full matrix launch planning after Gilardi and both Zheng canaries completed with zero failures.
